title: CognitionRecord
description: Closed standard cognition records for the spoke-cognition family: Belief, epistemic (knowledge/ignorance/undetermined) and Perception. Every completed standard record requires a declared foundational q for its identified cognitive assertion; a declared basis may remain uncalibrated and supplies no default probability, evidence, interval or calibration. Absent is never serialized as null. Expressed as closed variants because draft-07 conditionals (if/then/else) are not derivable by the codegen toolchain.

CognitionReferenceKind.title: CognitionReferenceKind
CognitionReferenceKind.description: Typed reference kind. `world` identifies the designated narrated-world authority and is invalid as the holder of Belief, epistemic or Perception records. Memory.subject_id is not implicitly a holder; a Memory cognition holder explicitly uses `memory_subject` when intended.

CognitionReference.title: CognitionReference

id.description: Non-empty, opaque within kind/namespace. Identity is never established by bare id or equal text.

namespace.description: Required identity realm for every kind; for `external` it is the declared external namespace. A reference's identity is the complete (kind, namespace, id) tuple. Pure validation checks only this shape — never global uniqueness, registry resolution or I/O.

CognitionReference.description: Complete namespace-bearing reference identity. Producers use one namespace only for ids assigned by the same identity authority; independent systems use distinct namespaces unless they deliberately share that authority.

CognitionTarget.title: CognitionTarget

about.description: Higher-order target; bounded by Belief order <= 3.

CognitionTarget.description: Compound target identity is (carrier, kind, target_id, assessment_context.context_id, assessment_context.fork_id). There is no target registry or lookup operation.

AssessmentBasis.title: AssessmentBasis
AssessmentBasis.description: Every completed standard assessment has either a non-empty evidence basis or an explicit declared subjective/prior/model basis. A declared basis may remain uncalibrated; it supplies no default probability, evidence, interval or calibration. Raw or unassessed source material remains outside CognitionRecord and has no AssessmentBasis.

evidence.description: Non-empty. Evidence references identify support only; they neither authenticate evidence nor grant access.

expression.description: Human/product-readable rule; not executable protocol logic.

ProbabilityUncertainty.title: ProbabilityUncertainty

lower.description: 0 <= lower <= upper <= 1 (upper bound enforced by validators; unquantified uncertainty is an absent `uncertainty`, never a fabricated zero-width interval).

level.description: 0 < level < 1 when the kind declares a nominal level.

description.description: Required when kind = "other" (enforced by validators; draft-07 conditionals are not derivable by the codegen toolchain).

ProbabilityUncertainty.description: Uncertainty describes the estimate; it is not another cognitive score.

CognitiveAssertion.title: CognitiveAssertion
CognitiveAssertion.description: The identified cognitive assertion q concerns; not extraction fidelity, world truth or a product prediction.

CalibrationStatus.title: CalibrationStatus
CalibrationStatus.description: Declared status of an estimator/method, not proof from one record.

DeclaredProbability.title: DeclaredProbability

value.description: Finite, 0..1. 0 and 1 are admitted only as deliberately assigned values, never label defaults.

DeclaredProbability.description: Required foundational q. Holder, target, assessor, basis, criterion where applicable, context and effective/assessment times plus q.assertion form the complete estimand identity.

CognitionMetric.title: CognitionMetric

criterion.description: Required for knowledge_criterion/correspondence estimands (enforced by validators; draft-07 conditionals are not derivable by the codegen toolchain).

CognitionMetric.description: Optional distinct metric. A metric key is present only when its distinct estimate exists; the key-to-estimand mapping is fixed and product-local measurements belong in existing extensions.<product>, not new keys.

CognitionMetrics.title: CognitionMetrics
CognitionMetrics.description: Category-compatible metrics only (Belief permits b/r; Perception permits p/f/r; epistemic permits k/r), enforced by validators.

CognitiveView.title: CognitiveView
CognitiveView.description: view = "current" is valid only in holder-side current input/authority; view = "recorded_at" is required in Memory and valid for explicitly supplied historical input. A projection does not change either value into an authority grant.

BeliefOrder.title: BeliefOrder
BeliefOrder.description: Higher-order depth. order 0 is retained for the shared vocabulary; current actor Belief records normally use 1-3 and narrated order-0 facts use WorldFactRecord.

target.description: Proposition or higher-order proposition target. For order = 1, target.about is absent; for order 2 or 3, about is present and the chain depth is consistent with order (chain never exceeds 3; enforced by validators).

assessed_at.description: When this assessor made the assessment.

q.description: assertion = belief_attribution; attribution confidence, never holder credence b.

EpistemicState.title: EpistemicState
EpistemicState.description: No-record is a projection state, not a fourth enum value.

classification_policy.description: Owns only categorical interpretation under the stated criterion.

q.description: known uses assertion = knowledge_criterion; ignorant uses ignorance_criterion; undetermined uses assessor_indeterminacy (q supplies no bound on knowledge and does not validate any attached metric).

ObservationAccess.title: ObservationAccess
ObservationAccess.description: Actual capture constraints if known; not event observability. Open: unknown keys round-trip verbatim.

PerceptionRecord.title: PerceptionRecord

target.description: Perceived_content or episode; target carrier/episode identity must agree with `episode` (enforced by validators).

content.description: Actual experienced/captured content; key required. Partial, misleading, illusory or disbelieved content remains valid.

access.description: Actual capture constraints if known; not event observability.

metrics.description: Optional metrics.f separately assesses correspondence under its own criterion.

PerceptionRecord.description: Perception is actual capture, separate from access metadata and optional correspondence. Event access alone never creates a Perception record or default p/q.

WorldFactRecord.title: WorldFactRecord

holder.description: kind = world; the designated narrated-world authority, never an actor holder.

WorldFactRecord.description: Narrated order-0 world facts; live on the designated world-state KnowledgeEntry and may be co-located only where the existing world-fact contract permits. holder still disambiguates.

CognitionModule.title: CognitionModule

records.description: BeliefRecord | EpistemicAssessment | PerceptionRecord. Current actor records live on the holder's KnowledgeEntry under modules.cognition.

CognitionModule.description: KnowledgeEntry.modules.cognition carrier. modules.belief retires as current authority; modules.mental.beliefs may contain only derivative summary/count/reference data. Other modules.mental values remain open and optional.

ObservationModule.title: ObservationModule

observers.description: Required; [] is explicitly no could-perceive observers. Missing module = no observation metadata; observers: [] = explicit empty could-perceive set; a Perception record = actual capture. None normalizes into another.

ObservationModule.description: TimelineEvent.modules.observation carrier: could-perceive access metadata, never actual capture.

ForkIdPredicate.title: ForkIdPredicate
ForkIdPredicate.description: Closed fork predicate: {eq: fork} addresses one fork identity; {absent: true} addresses the context identity whose stored fork_id is absent. An omitted fork_id is a wildcard over forked and no-fork contexts and is never an exact no-fork address.

QRange.title: QRange

max.description: Finite 0..1, inclusive; min <= max (enforced by validators).

QRange.description: Inclusive comparisons over the declared foundational q.value; uncalibrated but declared values participate identically. At least one of min/max required (minProperties 1); min <= max is enforced by validators.

TruthPredicate.title: TruthPredicate
TruthPredicate.description: Categorical predicate: {eq} matches only a present value; {absent: true} matches only an explicitly absent optional field. A required field cannot use the absent form.

CognitionFilter.title: CognitionFilter
CognitionFilter.description: All supplied predicates are ANDed on one record with the same holder/target/assessment context; predicates never join across different targets or records. Reference predicates compare the complete (kind, namespace, id) tuple; id predicates never compare bare strings across namespaces. There is no OR, text similarity, ranking, cutoff default, optional-metric filter, or implicit source/calibration/criterion constraint in the core grammar; schema-unknown predicates and unimplemented dimensions fail the whole request as unsupported_cognition_requirement (P2 behavior).

CognitionSelection.title: CognitionSelection

selection_policy.description: Explicitly supplied product policy; the library verifies only that the selected id belongs to the traced inputs and supplies no policy algorithm.

CognitionSelection.description: Scope.cognition carrier (capability-flagged; requires the negotiated spoke-cognition flag).

presence.description: A no_record item is emitted only when the filter exactly addresses holder + complete target identity + assessment context_id + an explicit fork predicate (eq or absent), and the authorized source has no record for that compound key before optional category/dimension/q predicates. An omitted fork_id is a wildcard and never produces no_record.

assessments.description: All retained authorized matching assessments; disagreements remain and selection does not overwrite or merge them.

selection.description: Required iff view = current and presence = assessed; recorded-at-time projection has no current selection.

CognitionProjection.title: CognitionProjection
CognitionProjection.description: Attribution-preserving projection with no projection-global effective context: every item carries its complete assessment_context, and one projection may retain items from different context ids and forks selected by the filter. A valid empty selection has items: [] and infers no context. MindState.cognition and AssemblePacket.cognition carry derivative projections; a current projection does not change either value into an authority grant.
